blocks.html: Our remote physiological monitoring program serving Round Rock TX is transforming the lives of many of our older patients. Physiologic monitors allow for early detection of vital sign deterioration, and it works to alert responders when situations become critical. With the use of visual and audible alarm signals, physiologic monitors will alert clinicians to changes to a patients’ condition, especially those that require immediate intervention.
